description: We are Whiplash!  We turn ideas into real solutions using AI, engineering, robotics, science and entrepreneurship. We built Evalify, an AI-powered CV and job-matching platform, and won 1st place in the Softtech Entrepreneurship category at the Fibonacci International Robot Olympiad. We also develop projects like SpectraBot and DeepLoRa. We seek curious, responsible teammates who love learning, teamwork and creating.
